title: Step 15 Page metric edge K_B profile from explicit U(2) formula
source: Toric-U-2-and-LeBrun-metrics object.md lines 319-340; Page parameter root of nu^4+4nu^3-6nu^2+12nu-3=0

K_B_profile_stats.interpretation: K_B varies mildly and changes sign (about -0.095 to 0.075 in this normalization/profile); Page is not a large negative edge-bubble model.

edge_flux_diagnostics_2pi_lattice_conven.expected_if_primitive_period_2pi: For the twist-free primitive rod convention one expects integral_(1-2K)qds=2 per edge. Deviations here are likely lattice/Euler-angle normalization and/or using the U(2) chart without converting to primitive toric coordinates.

use_for_step15: This partially completes target C for Page: it gives an explicit K_B edge/profile diagnostic from a source formula.
It does not yield a CLW profile; Hall-Murphy says CLW is cohomogeneity two and nonconstructive, so computing CLW edge K_B requires separate numerical extremal-Kahler data/code.
Page has m=4 and no boundary-bubble signature; it is a calibration example, not evidence about large-chi collapse.
